title: Safety controls demo — private and internal indicators
description: Every indicator here is non-routable, reserved or internal. HunterIntel classifies them locally and refuses to send them to any remote provider, so internal naming and addressing never leak to third parties. The investigation is TLP:RED, which also marks all members do-not-share. Enriching them demonstrates the blocked / policy states; no network request is made for any of them.

indicators.note: Internal DNS suffix: remote DNS/RDAP/CT lookups are blocked.
URL whose host is a private address.
TEST-NET-3 documentation address: not globally routable.
E-mail addresses are never sent as-is; DNS uses only the domain part and no third-party provider accepts e-mail.

notes: Try selecting a remote provider anyway: the query plan shows it as 'blocked' with the reason, and the server enforces this even for direct API calls.
